worldcombat.skill.shadowpunch.summary: The user stands still while a shadow runs from its feet into the target's shadow and a fist rises out of the target's own shadow; because the fist starts where the target stands, it cannot be anticipated, so it never misses. Grounding grabs and drags the target toward the user.
worldcombat.skill.shadowpunch.use.0: Raise a fist out of the target's own shadow
worldcombat.skill.shadowpunch.use.1: Hit a distant target without moving
worldcombat.skill.shadowpunch.use.2: Grab and drag a target with the shadow
worldcombat.skill.shadowpunch.descriptio: A contact punch of about %1$s; defence, type matchup and crit are settled on the hit.
The shadow runs into any target shadow within %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick.
The fist has a %1$s block collision radius and rises %2$s blocks out of the shadow.
worldcombat.skill.shadowpunch.hold.on: Grounding: the fist grabs the target and drags it %1$s blocks toward the user as control, at about 15%% less power.
worldcombat.skill.shadowpunch.hold.off: Ambush: no slow and no drag, about 18%% heavier.
worldcombat.skill.shadowpunch.timing: Cast on an enemy within %1$s blocks; windup %2$s s then costs %4$s PP, recover %3$s s, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.shadowpunch.growth.0: At level %1$s: punch power %2$s and reach %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.shadowpunch.growth.1: At level %1$s: punch power %2$s and drag %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.shadowpunch.preference: On (Grounding): the fist grabs and drags the target toward the user as control, at about 15%% less power. Off (Ambush): no slow and no drag, about 18%% heavier.
The user only punches at targets within this distance; larger values reach further.
On: an airborne enemy is a lower priority, because the shadow crawls along the ground; off: ignore whether the target is on the ground.
